Package index

End-to-End Orchestration & Supplement Export

High-level workflows for building complete reproducibility capsules and exporting zip-slip-safe journal peer-review supplements.

build_capsule()
Build a Complete Reproducibility Capsule for an R Project
export_capsule_bundle()
Export a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Supplement Bundle

Full-Stack Project & Toolchain Scanner

Static AST and project scanners resolving R packages, OS system libraries, compiled scientific toolchains, .Rprofile hazards, and architecture hints.

scan_project()
Scan an R Project for Dependencies, System Libraries, and Scientific Toolchains
sysreqs_db()
Built-in OS System Dependency (sysreqs) Registry
resolve_sysreqs()
Resolve OS System Dependencies for a Set of R Packages

Multi-Target Container Compilers, HPC Handoff & Linter

Generate, export, and audit pinned, layer-cached Dockerfiles, multi-service docker-compose.yml stacks, and HPC-ready Apptainer recipes and descriptors.

compile_dockerfile()
Compile a Layer-Cached Multi-Stage Dockerfile
compile_compose()
Compile a Production Multi-Service docker-compose.yml
compile_apptainer()
Compile an HPC-Ready Apptainer / Singularity Definition File
as_apptainer_spec()
Export a Structured Apptainer Recipe Descriptor for HPC Orchestrators
lint_container_spec()
Lint a Container Specification for Reproducibility and Security Issues

Cryptographic Provenance Manifests, SBOM & Cross-Run Diffing

Create, serialize, sign, verify, and diff tamper-evident capsule.json manifests and CycloneDX 1.5 Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).

create_capsule_manifest()
Create a Cryptographic Provenance Manifest (capsule.json)
write_capsule_manifest()
Write a Capsule Manifest to capsule.json
read_capsule_manifest()
Read a Capsule Manifest from capsule.json
sign_manifest()
Sign a Capsule Manifest with HMAC-SHA256
verify_manifest_integrity()
Verify Cryptographic Integrity and Signature of a Capsule Manifest
diff_capsules()
Diff Two Capsule Provenance Manifests Across Runs or Machines
export_sbom()
Export a CycloneDX 1.5 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
validate_sbom()
Validate a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM Document

Reproducibility Verification, Diagnostics & Certificates

Execute pipelines and external audit scripts in isolated sandboxes or Docker containers, diagnose reproducibility drift with ranked remediations, and render publication-ready verification certificates.

verify_capsule()
Verify Computational Reproducibility Against a Capsule Manifest
verify_with_script()
Execute an External Verification or Audit Script Inside the Isolated Sandbox
compare_artifacts()
Compare Two Output Artifacts with Exact SHA-256 and Numeric Tolerance
diagnose_reproducibility()
Diagnose Reproducibility Failures and Cross-Run Drift
render_certificate()
Render a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Verification Certificate

Runtime Capability Checks

docker_available()

apptainer_available()
